description:
Powerful 750W Peak Smooth Commute Power

Rated 500W brushless motor with 750W peak output, delivers steady acceleration and climbs up to 30° slopes safely, locked max speed 20MPH, ideal for daily city commuting and weekend leisure rides.

Long-Range IPX4 Waterproof Removable Battery

48V 13Ah lithium battery supports up to 70 miles per full charge, fully charged within 4-6 hours. IPX4 waterproof design works reliably in light rain, detachable for convenient indoor charging and anti-theft storage.

User-Friendly Low Step-Thru Comfort Frame

Ergonomic low step frame allows easy mounting & dismounting, fits riders 5'2'' to 6'5''. Lightweight structure with front suspension fork cushions bumpy city roads for all-day comfortable riding.

Durable City Riding Full Configuration

26-inch puncture-resistant anti-slip tires adapt to streets and light trails. Sturdy frame supports up to 330lbs load, matched rear cargo rack, front headlight and mudguards to meet daily shopping and travel demands.

Quick Assembly & Complete Supporting Accessories

85% pre-assembled design, you can finish simple installation within minutes. Full package includes charger, tool kit, rearview mirror, mudguards and user manual, with long-term professional after-sales support for all usage issues.
